course_name_original: Càlcul d'Estructures de Formigó Armat. Fonamentacions (EM1042)
prerequisites: EM1012 - Mechanics of Machines and Structures
EM1019 - Elasticity and Strength of Materials
EM1020 - Theory of Machines and Mechanisms

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to organize teamwork for reinforced concrete structure projects within an established timeframe.
Be able to solve problems of dimensioning simple structural elements and reinforced concrete foundation elements.
Be able to build models of reinforced concrete bar structures, check their dimensioning, and design new structures using commercial software tools.
Correctly use the basic technical terminology of concrete structure design, in English.
Be able to analyze and dimension reinforced concrete structures different from those analyzed in class autonomously.
Be able to explain the components, manufacturing process, and properties of reinforced concrete as a structural material.
Be able to apply the current regulations applicable to reinforced concrete as a structural material.
Be able to select the most suitable typology in each case and dimension the foundation elements for industrial constructions and equipment.
Be able to dimension reinforced concrete structural elements based on the theory of ultimate limit states and serviceability limit states.

syllabus_topics: 1.4. Types of concretes according to reinforcement and examples
Topic 2: Materials used: concrete and steel
3.2. Identification of the type of environment
Topic 4. Calculation of concrete structures against fire
4.3. Properties of materials with increasing temperature
4.7. Damage to concrete structures after a fire
Topic 6: Dimensioning of linear reinforced concrete elements. Analysis of ultimate limit states
6.1. Ultimate limit state of exhaustion under normal stresses
6.3. Ultimate limit state of exhaustion under shear
Topic 7: Dimensioning of linear reinforced concrete elements. Analysis of serviceability limit states
10.5. Calculation of the thickness of an industrial pavement.
1. Study the work to be calculated.
2. Correctly save the multiple information of the work
Analysis of results. Correction and adjustment of the work.
assessment_rules: To pass the course, at least 5 out of 10 points must be obtained in the overall qualification. For the first call, the overall qualification is the average of Continuous Assessment (50%) and the Final Exam (50%). A minimum of 4.5 out of 10 points is essential in the final exam; if not met, and the global average is above 4.5 points, a qualification of 4.5 will be recorded. For the second call, the overall qualification is the average of Continuous Assessment (30%) and the Final Exam (70%); practical lab work is not recoverable and has no minimum mark, while practical project work is recoverable if below 5/10.
